parts.title: Introduction
parts.hint: 1 câu. Paraphrase lại đề bài: đổi động từ, đổi cách nói chủ thể, đổi cách nói thời gian.
parts.formula: [Loại biểu đồ] + [Động từ] + [Chủ thể đã paraphrase] + [Nơi chốn] + [Thời gian].
examples: The bar chart illustrates the proportion of government spending on roads and transport in 4 nations between 1990 and 2005.
The line graph demonstrates the percentage of tourists to England who visited four different attractions in Brighton from 1980 to 2010.

parts.title: Overview
parts.hint: 2–3 câu. Nêu xu hướng chung + đối lập, rồi nêu cái cao nhất/thấp nhất. TUYỆT ĐỐI không có số liệu.
parts.formula: Overall, it is clear that [xu hướng nhóm A] while the opposite trend was true for [nhóm B]. In addition, [item] had the highest/lowest figure throughout the period.
chips: increased while the opposite trend was true for
decreased while the opposite was true for
had the highest figure throughout the period.
had the lowest figure throughout the period.
examples: Overall, it is clear that the percentages of government spending in Italia, Portugal and the UK decreased while the opposite was true for the USA. Moreover, the figure for Portugal was the highest throughout the period, except in 2000.

Overall, contributions of agriculture and manufacturing declined significantly while business and financial services showed a steady increase. Moreover, despite contributing the least in 1900, business and finance became the leading sector by 2000.

parts.title: Body 1
parts.hint: Mở đầu bằng câu tín hiệu, rồi tả có số liệu. Nhớ nêu đỉnh / đáy / vượt mặt.
parts.formula: It can be seen from the graph that … In [năm đầu], the number of [A] was the highest, at [số], compared with [số] of [B]. Two years later, the figure for [A] + [Verb] + [Adverb] + to [số].
chips: It can be seen from the graph that
examples: It can be seen from the graph that the percentages of government spending in Portugal and Italia were the most significant. In 1990, the proportion of government spending in Portugal was the highest, at around 27%, compared with around 22% of Italia.

parts.title: Body 2
parts.hint: Mở bằng liên từ đối lập, tả nhóm còn lại, cũng phải có số liệu.
parts.formula: By contrast, [câu topic sentence]. [Số liệu] + [C] + [Verb], which was followed by a/an + Adj + Noun. [Liên từ], the figure for [D] …
chips: at the end of the period.
examples: By contrast, the proportions of government spending in the USA and the UK were the smallest. In 1990, the figure of the USA was around 11%, compared with 10% of the UK. However, its figure rose significantly to 15% at the end of the period.
